turns.prompt: when I end a meeting, the recap leaves out any task that has a person on it but no deadline. like if they say 'Priya will send the contract' with no date it just isnt in the action items. can you fix it
turns.final_message:
I made a prompt fix, but I couldn't find any code that drops undated tasks, so I haven't confirmed this was the cause. I also haven't run a real meeting through it yet.

**What I checked:** When a meeting ends, `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts` asks the LLM for the notes and saves what comes back. I found no filter that drops tasks without a date: not in that file's parsing, not in `TranscriptPreprocessor`, and not in how `MeetingDetails.tsx` shows the list. The rule "keep owner-but-no-date items" exists, but only in prompts in `electron/llm/prompts.ts` that the end-of-meeting recap doesn't use. The recap's own prompt never mentions dates. The Groq version's only example item has a date ("Bob: Draft invite copy by Wednesday"), which nudges the model toward leaving out items without one. So the likely cause is the model leaving them out, not the code deleting them.

**What I changed:**
- `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`: added a rule to the recap prompt to include every task that has an owner, even with no date. It shows "Priya will send the contract" becoming "Priya: send the contract (no date given)" and says never to make up a date. This covers both the Team Meet notes and the general notes.
- `electron/llm/prompts.ts` (`GROQ_SUMMARY_JSON_PROMPT`): added the same rule, so Groq users get it too.

Because this is a prompt change, it should make dropped items much rarer but can't guarantee they never happen.

**To confirm:** record a short test meeting that includes a line like "Priya will send the contract" with no date, and see if it shows up under Action items. Or give me the title of a past meeting where a task went missing. The app's saved meetings are in `~/Library/Application Support/natively`, and I can compare that meeting's transcript to its saved notes. I didn't open that folder because it holds your meeting transcripts.

- **The app in `/Applications/Natively.app` is an old build.** It's dated May 10 and has its own bundled copy of the code. Editing the source files here doesn't touch it.

- **The meeting you tested probably didn't use this data at all.** `~/Library/Application Support/natively/natively.db` was last changed July 12, so no meeting from today was saved there. I didn't open the database itself.

To actually test the fix, the repo needs `npm install` and then `npm run app:dev`. The install isn't small: besides the packages, it rebuilds native modules and downloads speech models. I can run it here if you want. It may also hit the sandbox's network limits, and if it does I'll tell you what was blocked.

Two things would help me narrow this down:
1. How did you test it? With the app in `/Applications`, or something you started from this folder?
2. Was the meeting in Team Meet mode, and did you use Groq or another model? Those take different paths through the prompts.

One more caveat even after it's running: this is a prompt change, so it makes dropped tasks less likely but can't guarantee none get dropped. If you still see misses after testing the real build, I'll add a code check that compares the saved action items against lines in the transcript like "X will Y" and adds back any that are missing. Want me to start the install?
